local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu']
local s=cpu.spaces['program']
local dbg=assert(manager.machine.debugger,'debugger must be enabled')
local active=true local inspecting=false local hits=0 local control=false
local taps={}
local function context(tag,a,d,m,page,physical)
 inspecting=true
 print(string.format('[CONTEXT-BEGIN] tag=%s addr=%04x data=%04x mask=%04x page=%04x physical=%06x',tag,a,d,m,page,physical))
 for name,state in pairs(cpu.state) do
  print(string.format('[REGISTER] %s=%x',name,state.value))
 end
 for selector=0x100,0x10e,2 do print(string.format('[SELECTOR] %04x=%04x',selector,s:read_u16(selector))) end
 local before=#dbg.consolelog
 dbg:command('history :maincpu,20')
 for line=before+1,#dbg.consolelog do print('[HISTORY] '..tostring(dbg.consolelog[line])) end
 print('[CONTEXT-END] '..tag)
 inspecting=false
end
-- Page base granularity is 400h, so all aliases retain low ten bits 103h.
for addr=0x0102,0xfd02,0x400 do
 local a0=addr
 taps[#taps+1]=s:install_read_tap(a0,a0+1,'residual-byte-'..a0,function(a,d,m)
  if not active or inspecting or (m & 0xff00)==0 then return end
  local logical=a+1 local page=s:read_u16(0x108+2*(logical >> 14))
  local physical=(page << 10)+(logical & 0x3fff)
  if physical>=0x1e0000 and physical<=0x1fffff and (physical & 0x7fff)==0x6903 then
   hits=hits+1 context('TARGET',logical,d,m,page,physical)
  end
 end)
end
positive=s:install_read_tap(0x8904,0x8905,'history-positive-control',function(a,d,m)
 if active and not inspecting and not control and (m & 255)~=0 and s:read_u16(0x10c)==0x798 then
  control=true context('KNOWN-FDC-TEMPLATE',a,d,m,0x798,0x1e6904)
 end
end)
finish=s:install_write_tap(0x106,0x107,'residual-handoff',function(a,d,m)
 if active and cpu.state['PC'].value==0x4755 then
  print(string.format('[ROM-HANDOFF] target_reads=%d positive_control=%s',hits,tostring(control))) active=false
 end
end)
local frames=0
emu.register_frame_done(function()
 frames=frames+1
 if frames%300==0 then print(string.format('[WATCH-STATE] frame=%d pc=%04x target_reads=%d positive_control=%s',frames,cpu.state['PC'].value,hits,tostring(control))) end
end)

local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu']
local space=cpu.spaces['program']
local function field(port,name) for _,f in pairs(manager.machine.ioport.ports[port].fields) do if f.name==name then return f end end error('input missing') end
local mode=field(':PANEL1','Mode')
local up=field(':PANEL1','Panel Up')
local inc=field(':PANEL0','S2')
local dec=field(':PANEL0','S1')
local exit=field(':PANEL1','Exit')
mode:set_value(1)
local frames=0
local stage=0
local cooldown=0
local held=nil
local writes=0
local timeout_reads=0
timeout_tap=space:install_read_tap(0xe408,0xe409,'absent-timeout',function(a,d,m)
 if (d&4)~=0 then timeout_reads=timeout_reads+1 if timeout_reads<25 then print(string.format('[TIMEOUT] pc=%04x value=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,d)) end end
end)
last_boot=space:install_write_tap(0x4cb2,0x4cb3,'last-boot-source',function(a,d,m)
 if (m&0xff00)~=0 then print(string.format('[LAST-BOOT] pc=%04x value=%02x',cpu.state['PC'].value,(d>>8)&255)) end
end)
scsi_tap=space:install_write_tap(0xe400,0xe41f,'boot-scsi',function(a,d,m)
if writes<4096 then print(string.format('[SCSI] pc=%04x addr=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,a,d,m)) end writes=writes+1
end)
handoff=space:install_write_tap(0x0106,0x0107,'handoff',function(a,d,m) print(string.format('[HANDOFF] pc=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,d,m)) end)
local function pulse(f,name) f:set_value(1) held=f cooldown=30 print('[INPUT] '..name) end
emu.register_frame_done(function()
frames=frames+1
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value
if held then held:set_value(0) held=nil end
if cooldown>0 then cooldown=cooldown-1 end
if stage==0 then
 mode:set_value(1)
 if frames>90 and pc>=0x5741 and pc<=0x5809 then mode:set_value(0) stage=1 cooldown=30 print('[ENTERED] setup') end
elseif stage==1 and cooldown==0 then
 local selection=space:read_u8(0x4d30)
 if selection>1 then pulse(up,'Panel Up') elseif selection==1 then stage=2 cooldown=30 else error('unexpected selection') end
elseif stage==2 and cooldown==0 then
 local boot=space:read_u8(0x4caf)
 if boot<2 then pulse(inc,'S2') elseif boot>2 then pulse(dec,'S1') else stage=3 cooldown=30 end
elseif stage==3 and cooldown==0 then pulse(exit,'Exit') stage=4 end
if frames%60==0 then print(string.format('[STATE] frame=%d pc=%04x stage=%d field=%02x boot=%02x target=%02x type=%02x',frames,pc,stage,space:read_u8(0x4d30),space:read_u8(0x4caf),space:read_u8(0x4c51),space:read_u8(0x4c5b))) end
end)
